programme.title: South Park: Trapper Keeper
programme.desc: Trapper Keeper: Cartman is none too happy when 'Bill Cosby' tells him his ultra-advanced Trapper Keeper 2000 is destined to become sentient and wipe out humanity. That kinda sucks ay? (S4, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Helen Keller! The Musical
programme.desc: Helen Keller! The Musical: The boys stage a Thanksgiving play about the life of author Helen Keller, starring Timmy as Helen. There's trouble involving his favourite turkey, Gobbles. (S4, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Pip!
programme.desc: Pip (a.k.a. Great Expectations): South Park's unusual version of the classic Dickens tale, featuring robot monkeys and the Genesis Device! Narrated in vision by Malcolm McDowell. (S4, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Fat Camp
programme.desc: Fat Camp: Cartman is sent to fat camp in order to resolve his weight problem but all is not as it seems when he returns skinny. Kenny gets his own TV show where he performs disgusting acts. (S4, E15)

programme.title: South Park: The Wacky Molestation Adventure
programme.desc: The Wacky Molestation Adventure: Kyle has his parents arrested so he can go to a concert but things get out of hand and it's not long before there are no adults left in town! (S4, E16)

programme.title: South Park: A Very Crappy Christmas
programme.desc: A Very Crappy Christmas: When Mr Hankey fails to show up at Christmas time the boys go looking for him in the sewers. Can the gang revive the spirit of Christmas with their own cartoon? (S4, E17)

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman Must Die
programme.desc: Scott Tenorman Must Die: Cartman is tricked into buying pubic hair by Scott Tenorman. Outraged at being laughed at, he plots the most sickest, evil revenge possible... Radiohead guest star. (S5, E04)

programme.title: South Park: It Hits the Fan
programme.desc: It Hits The Fan: Swearing on a TV show leads to mass profanity in South Park. What does this have to do with The Black Death?! The you-know-what-hits the fan 162 times in this ep! (S5, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Cr***le Fight
programme.desc: Cr***le Fight: It's Timmy vs. Jimmy! But does Jimmy know this? The boys are joining the Scouts (troop 69) but their parents aren't so sure when they discover who the Scout Leader is. (S5, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Terrance and Phillip: Behind the Blow
programme.desc: Terrance and Phillip - Behind The Blow: The boys face death at the hands of some unhinged environmentalists unless they can re-unite Terrance and Phillip for a show at Earth Day Festival! (S5, E05)
programme.sub-title: Terrance and Phillip: Behind the Blow

programme.title: South Park: Cartmanland
programme.desc: Cartmanland: When Cartman inherits $1million and purchases his own theme park, Stan starts to question his faith in God. It's not long before things start to go out of control for Cartman. (S5, E06)

programme.title: A Haunting: Field Of Ghosts
programme.desc: For as long as she can remember, Markie Beason has sensed something horrible happened in her home and becomes frightened to be alone in the house. Her father David, reaches out to a paranormal investigation group in hopes they can bring peace to the home.

programme.title: A Haunting: Spirits of the Dead
programme.desc: The Whitley’s buy a farmhouse that houses a negative presence. The presence turns physical.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Haunting Of Allen House
programme.desc: Professor Mark Spencer and his wife Rebecca have just purchased the historic Allen House in Arkansas. Shortly after moving in, Rebecca comes face to face with a faceless spirit. Mark calls investigators to determine if the spirit means them harm.

programme.title: A Haunting: Ghost Inferno
programme.desc: Kim and Craig move into their dream home in rural Bagley, Iowa with Kim’s two young daughters. When an unseen entity attacks the family, Kim and Craig realize they could be dealing with a ghost. They turn to a demonologist to help them reclaim the house.

programme.title: A Haunting: Living Nightmare
programme.desc: Angela, a newlywed, is excited to start her new life with Stephen when nightmares that she experienced as a child suddenly resurface. Soon the menacing old hag from her dreams terrorizes her daughter and takes temporary possession of her son.

programme.title: A Haunting: Casa de los Muertos
programme.desc: Eddie Benitez fears the spirit of a dead man who committed suicide is slowly killing his son.

programme.title: A Haunting: Black Magic
programme.desc: During the renovation of her 150-year-old Pennsylvania home, Debbie Guy accepts the old house has a ghost and they will have to live with it. But when family members are tormented by an evil entity, Debbie seeks the help of paranormal investigators.

programme.title: A Haunting: Fear Feeders
programme.desc: Soon after Al Gonzalez purchases a home outside Fort Wayne, Indiana, he begins to hear strange noises and sees unexplainable shadows. Paranormal investigators determine the entities in Al's home are dangerous and that he is not their first victim.

programme.title: A Haunting: Demon Child
programme.desc: Jan’s young son Cody begins communicating with an imaginary friend. She calls on a shaman.

programme.title: A Haunting: Immortal Love
programme.desc: Shortly after Whitney's family moving into their first home, a restless spirit shatters the serenity of their suburban life. Whitney calls in a paranormal team who uncover the truth behind the spirit's tragic death and his intense obsession with Whitney.

programme.title: A Haunting: Hidden Terror
programme.desc: After Mike and Lisa move in their new house, Lisa’s personality begins to change dramatically.

programme.title: A Haunting: Portal Of Doom
programme.desc: Anita Intenzo and her son, Chris, encounter the ghost of their recently deceased friend Paul while preparing his house to be sold. Paul warns of a demon attached to an artifact he acquired abroad. The demon invades Anita’s home and all hell breaks loose.

programme.title: A Haunting: Hell House
programme.desc: Bonnie and her family buy a farmhouse and they sense that they are being watched.

programme.title: A Haunting: Death's Door

programme.title: A Haunting: The Dark Side
programme.desc: The Wilcott’s 5-year-old son is attacked by an unseen entity. Their only hope is an exorcism.

programme.title: A Haunting: Ashes To Evil

programme.title: A Haunting: The Presence
programme.desc: Sarah Miller believes that something supernatural in her home is terrorizing her children.

programme.title: A Haunting: Child’s Play

programme.title: Born to Kill?
programme.desc: A young couple from Canada were serial killers capable of severe cruelty. They targeted young women, including a relative of one of the perpetrators, in a series of crimes that would horrify the nation.

programme.title: Born to Kill?

programme.title: Born to Kill?
programme.desc: Robert Napper wreaks terror on south London, murdering two women and a child.

programme.title: Born to Kill?

programme.title: Born to Kill?

programme.title: Born to Kill?
programme.desc: Cinema entrepreneur Peter Moore brutally murdered four men in Wales in 1995.

programme.title: Born to Kill?

programme.title: Born to Kill?

programme.title: Born to Kill?

programme.title: Born to Kill?

programme.sub-title: My Husband Spanked Me With A Spoon: He Wants An Apology Pt.2

programme.sub-title: The Battle Between Kay And Kathy Continues Pt.2

programme.desc: Holly posts the Body Confidence photos and is noticed by a Kardashian! Aaron's eyeing his first boxing match and Marnie falls in love with a million-pound pad. (S4, ep6)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Holly turns to the spiritual world for wedding answers. Marnie's million pound home offer is accepted and Talia's waters break prematurely, sparking dramatic events. (S4, ep7)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Aaron's worried when Talia has to stay in hospital. Sophie embraces single life and Holly's pleased when Jacob meets an Ex-Pro to talk about life after football. (S4, ep8)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Maddox is home but Talia's struggling post C-Section. Sophie invests in her own beauty business. Marnie's dream house move might be back on and Government travel restrictions impact Holly. (S4, ep9)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Aaron misses his train to a press conference announcing his big fight, will he make it in time? Holly gets a tattoo removed and Marnie has her baby scan. Gary invites Aaron to meet Chester. (S1, ep1)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie and Casey do a photo shoot for OK! Magazine. Holly takes a class in public speaking and it's date night for Gary and Emma. The stress of Aaron's upcoming fight is beginning to show. (S1, ep2)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie gives Casey a sexy birthday present. Holly faces her fears at Sussex Uni. Aaron meets up with Nathan and Sam to talk about mental health. Emma has a big surprise for Gary. (S1, ep3)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie shows off her baby bump in a magazine shoot. Gary plays golf with Chris Hughes. Aaron's shocked to find out who his opponent is in his MMA fight and Holly says a tearful goodbye. (S1, ep4)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Gary and Emma share some special news and Aaron gets stuck into training. Holly goes to the House of Lords and Marnie and Casey get a shock when an photo of Casey is sent to a newspaper. (S1, ep5)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie could give birth at any moment. Sophie opens up to Holly about her heartbreak. Chester gives Gary the run around and Aaron faces up to the reality of becoming a Dad. (S2, ep1)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Gary plans a life-changing surprise for Emma. Holly goes to see some unicorns. Sophie struggles to forget her ex and Marnie has a traumatic labour. (S2, ep2)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Sophie gets ready to celebrate her 30th birthday in style. Marnie adjusts to her new life. Holly takes Jacob shopping and Gary prepares to go down on one knee. (S2, ep3)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie's illness catches up with her. Gary takes Aaron "Dad training" and Sophie receives some devastating news. (S2, ep4)

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: It’s proper awks between the newbies, while Scotty T and Abbie begin to get closer. Zahida goes mental at Marty and Gaz gets his revenge on Sam. Marnie's back and gets properly mortal. (S14, ep8)

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: It's the squad's last days on the piste. Aaron is on the pull with wingman Gaz, it's pure awks between Abbie and Sarah over Scotty T, and things get worse when he tries it on with Zahida. (S14, ep9)

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: The Squad head back to the toon and give the newbies their most brutal initiation yet! Zahida and Scotty get closer but will they be able to keep it a secret? Boss Anna has some big news. (S14, ep10)

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Marty gets mortal and fancies a blast from the past... Sarah. But will Chloe be cool? Zahida tries to clear the air with Sarah and Abbie, but things quickly go west and it all kicks off! (S14, ep11)

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: In the season finale, the Geordies throw a huge house party for Nathan. It’s decision time for Boss Anna as she reveals whether it's Abbie, Sarah or Zahida who joins the family for good. (S14, ep12)

programme.title: JAG: To Walk on Wings
programme.desc: Congresswoman Latham and a colleague watch four marine jumpers jump into the ocean from an M22 Osprey. With two marines left to jump, the plane is struck by a swell in the ocean. Harm and Mac are instructed to investigate.

programme.title: JAG: Guilt
programme.desc: When Captain Huddleston hears that the marine corporal has been charged with rape, he sends Lt. Colonel Sarah Mac MacKenzie to handle the case in a hot zone of Anti-American activity.

programme.title: JAG: Mixed Messages
programme.desc: An intruder shoots three Navy people, killing two. One of the dead is a friend of Harm, who protects his reputation. Webb, counter-espionage, and disinformation are involved; Bud solves it. Mac and Renee return to town; Mac leaves again.

programme.title: JAG: Ambush
programme.desc: Capt. Shepard leads his troop off its peacekeeping mission and into battle with the colonel of the rebel forces. Consequently, six marines die in the public incident. Harm is sent in to investigate despite a recent touch of bad luck in a string of trials.

programme.title: JAG: Jag-a-thon
programme.desc: The JAG gang takes part in a JAGathon, a charity-benefit marathon, which provides opportunities for personal pride and individual competitiveness. Sturgis feels uncertain, and Harm defends a sailor for impersonating an officer.

programme.title: JAG: The Mission
programme.desc: A spotter on the ground calls for an airstrike as he has identified 15 heavily armed suspected Al Qaeda members on horseback. JAG won’t approve the airstrike until the spotter is absolutely certain the men are Al Qaeda members.

programme.title: JAG: Defending His Honor
programme.desc: An ambulance pulls up to a crash site where a woman, Jennifer Wilson, is found injured and crying for her baby. Unbeknownst to her, the six-month-old baby died in the accident. A Navy judge stands accused of vehicular homicide.

programme.title: JAG: In Country
programme.desc: Central Command coordinates an airstrike on a confirmed target traveling through Afghanistan. After the strike is launched, marine troops assess the damage and they are disturbed to learn that they targeted the wrong vehicle and hit civilians instead.

programme.title: JAG: Enemy Below
programme.desc: Kabir is preparing an attack against the U.S. and was last seen crossing the border from Afghanistan to Iran. He is believed to have recruited Capt. Yerastov, a Russian submarine captain. Turner, Harm and Mac help in the hunt for the terrorists.

programme.title: JAG: Critical Condition
programme.desc: Bud has lost his right lower leg due to a mine in Afghanistan; during emergency surgery he faces bad trouble. Sturgis returns to Washington, and Harm and Mac disobey an order from the admiral. Bud encounters an astounding change of course.

programme.title: JAG: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: A deputy sheriff dies while chasing a car carrying two SEALs in a Navy exercise. The driver stands trial for negligent homicide.

programme.title: JAG: In Thin Air
programme.desc: Lt. Albrecht and Lt. Cmdr. Zuzello make Zuzello’s farewell flight before he retires. All is fine until Albrecht notices that his partner is passed out from hypoxia. Albrecht makes an emergency landing on the ship.Harm is sent to the ship to investigate.

programme.title: JAG: Need to Know
programme.desc: As a favor from Congresswoman Lillian Dorning, SECNAV Sheffield asks the JAG staff to get the story of a submarine, USS Angel Shark (SSGN-559), which was lost on a CIA mission in 1968.

programme.title: JAG: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Harm serves as a judge and Mac is the contentious prosecutor in a case fraught withpolitical implications when an American aviator is charged with killing three Britishsoldiers during a flight mission in Afghanistan.

programme.title: JAG: Shifting Sands
programme.desc: When a Gulf War MIA victim is found as the sheik’s wife in a nomadic Arab tribe, Bud prosecutes and Mac defends her against charges of desertion and, in a stunning turn of events, treason. Harm tries to get his old job back but is turned away.

programme.title: JAG: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Mac defends and Turner prosecutes in the case of a special op marine who, during an Iraqi mission, may have deserted his team for his own survival. Harm takes on a CIA training assignment in a mach six craft that soon has him in danger.

programme.title: JAG: Close Quarters
programme.desc: Back at JAG, Harm is flooded with cases but still wants to help out an 80-year-old veteran accused of robbery. Meanwhile, Turner takes on an assignment in a sub whose crew has rescued possible defecting North Koreans.

programme.title: JAG: Posse Comitatus
programme.desc: Harm and Mac argue the case of a Marine pilot who used force to interfere with a local police matter that led to a man’s killing. Roberts is the investigating officer in the matter of a Navy doctor who is requesting conscientious objector status.

programme.title: JAG: The Boast
programme.desc: When an unwitting corporal boasts to a reporter that he killed an Iraqi prisoner of war, facts begin to emerge that could convict him despite his later claim that he was only lying toi mpress.

programme.title: JAG: Pulse Rate
programme.desc: Harm and Mac go aboard the USS Gillcrist to determine if a seaman’s fatal accident during a routine repair was the result of a co-worker’s dereliction of duty or worse.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Liz Moves In
programme.desc: Liz temporarily moves in with Jeff and Audrey. Jeff isn't happy with the new guest, but changes his mind when he discovers Liz consistently takes his side against Audrey.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Taking Names
programme.desc: Jeff and Audrey realize that the names on their baby list are also the names of women that Russell has slept with. Adam becomes a cycling enthusiast after Jennifer suggests they start riding bikes in the park.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Feeling lonely after her cat dies, Liz looks for a sperm donor. When Timmy's intellect and innocence don't attract his crush, he tries his hand at playing 'big dog.' Adam rips the vintage wedding dress that Jennifer's family sent her.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Cupcake
programme.desc: Russell gets jealous when Timmy manages to outshine him at his own pick-up game. Adam and Jennifer leave pot-laced cupcakes on the kitchen counter, and an unaware Jeff eats one.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Fountain Of Youth
programme.desc: After meeting up with college friends who are no longer into partying, Jeff and Audrey set out to prove that even with a baby on the way, they can still have fun. Meanwhile, Timmy attempts to find Russell's compassionate side.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Baby Talk
programme.desc: When Audrey bonds with their unborn baby by reading her stories, a paranoid Jeff believes that she is trying to form an alliance against him. Meanwhile, Russell steals an article that Timmy wrote.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Role Play
programme.desc: Jeff promises to take Audrey to an upmarket and very popular restaurant but forgets to book a table. Determined to dine there, he hatches a plan to get in by claiming that a last-minute reservation is needed for a celebrity.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Catering
programme.desc: Brenda enlists Jeff and Audrey's help when she does the catering for an event at Columbia University. While waitressing, Audrey tries to fit in with the guests, only to discover that they are more impressed with Jeff's bartending skills.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Cooking Class
programme.desc: The couples attempt to enjoy recreational cooking classes together, but Jeff and Adam can't keep their competitive nature out of the kitchen. Russell doesn't notice how disturbingly similar his new girlfriend is to Timmy.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Unpleasant Surprises
programme.desc: When Jennifer learns that the guys have nothing planned for Adam's last weekend as a bachelor, she plans a party weekend. Things don't go as planned, however, so Jeff, Russell, and Timmy must improvise.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Timmy Quits
programme.desc: Audrey has always had suspicions that Jeff's old college friend Heidi harbours romantic feelings for him, so Jeff invites Heidi over to prove that this was never the case.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: A Wee Problem
programme.desc: Jeff does his best to make a heavily pregnant Brenda laugh when he discovers that she has a `wee problem' due to her condition, but his antics cause her waters to break. Meanwhile, Adam annoys Audrey with his non-stop chatter during a spa visit.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: 100th
programme.desc: Brenda goes into labor on Jen and Adam's wedding day, but Jeff has reservations about being in the delivery room. Adam persuades Jen to make some alternative arrangements for their marriage ceremony.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Rules of Engagement: Pilot
programme.desc: Adam and Jennifer are a 20-something couple who have gotten engaged and moving in together after just seven months of dating. Meanwhile, their neighbors Jeff and Audrey who have been married for twelve years try to set a good example.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: The Birthday Deal
programme.desc: Though he's unhappy that Audrey spent more than usual for his birthday party, Jeff wants to stay on her good side to ensure he gets his yearly birthday deal. Though Jeff won't reveal the 'deal.'

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: The Young and the Restless
programme.desc: After Adam has too many restless nights sleeping in Jennifer’s small bed, he brings home the bed he shared with his ex-girlfriend which causes a fight and leads them tossing out all memories of past relationships.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Hard Day's Night
programme.desc: Jennifer tries to help Jeff’s sore neck with a massage until the situation between them becomes uncomfortable and upsets Audrey. Meanwhile, Russell brings Adam along to help him fight off a school yard bully so Russell can get close to the teacher.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Kids
programme.desc: Adam and Jennifer’s plans for a romantic weekend fall apart after they argue about their different feelings toward careers, finances, and kids. Meanwhile, Audrey is having second thoughts about why she and Jeff have waited so long to have children.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Game on
programme.desc: After Adam buys an expensive video-game console, Jennifer makes him promise to discuss major purchases first, but Russell interferes and makes Adam question the agreement.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Jeff's Wooby
programme.desc: Audrey surprises Jeff by making quilt out of his old t-shirts but regrets her gift when he doesn't stop telling the stories that are behind the shirts.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Mr. Fix-It
programme.desc: Jeff and Audrey tackle marital communication issues while Adam and Jennifer discover whether creating a home-made 'videotape' will spice up their love life.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Flirting With Disaster
programme.desc: Adam enjoys stealing the attention of Russell's female admirers, prompting fiance Jennifer to lay down the law and Russell to seek revenge. Meanwhile, Jeff learns an important lesson about sleep deprivation.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Audrey's Sister
programme.desc: A surprise visit from Audrey's sister Barbara opens a window of opportunity for Russell to prove that beauty is more than what meets the eye - or at least a function of personality and good strategy.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Guy Code
programme.desc: In an effort to beef up their social agenda, Audrey persuades Jeff to double-date, which inadvertently puts the rules governed by the 'guy code' versus the 'marriage code' to the test.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Engagement Party
programme.desc: In an effort to capitalize on his commitment to Jennifer, Adam convinces Jeff to host an engagement party, which ultimately provides a lesson in 'giving' and 'receiving.' Audrey gains an unsolicited insight into her sister Barbara's single life.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Bag Ladies
programme.desc: Russell realizes the cost of dating a 'bag lady,' while Adam experiences the social peril of yielding to Jennifer's wishes and sporting a 'man bag.'

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Old School Jeff
programme.desc: Jeff is given an opportunity to 'live it up' during a night out on the town, landing Russell in hot water and Adam to reflect on the details surrounding his impending nuptials.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Fix-Ups and Downs
programme.desc: Jennifer and Audrey practice their match-making skills and inadvertently end up date-less while Adam and Jeff score financial gain in the process. Meanwhile, Russell tries a new tactic at 'fixing himself up.'

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: A Visit from Fay
programme.desc: A visit from Adam's free-spirited mother puts Jennifer's patience to the test and teaches Russell an embarrassing lesson about 'art'. Meanwhile, Jeff and Audrey find themselves enjoying alternative forms of entertainment.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Time Share
programme.desc: Jeff makes plans to take Audrey away for the weekend to a fancy hotel, even though they’ll have to sit through a time share presentation to get a great deal.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Jen at Work
programme.desc: Adam suggests that Jen do some freelance graphic design work for the company but Russell isn't crazy about the idea.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Optimal Male
programme.desc: Jeff's drive to be labeled an 'optimal male' on his life-insurance physical leads him to some extreme behavior, while Adam's over-friendliness with an ex-girlfriend unsettles Jennifer.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Russell's Father's Son
programme.desc: Russell puts on a show to impress his father when he comes to town, but both he and Adam learn the meaning of a parent's tough love. Meanwhile, an 'accident' in their apartment forces Adam and Jennifer to invade Audrey and Jeff's bathroom.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Buyer's Remorse
programme.desc: Jennifer and Adam attempt to practice fiscal responsibility as they consider buying their apartment. Audrey and Jeff offer to write their letter of recommendation, but end up making matters worse when they have a run-in with the landlady.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Pimp My Bride
programme.desc: Russell reluctantly agrees to host a photo shoot in his apartment for Audrey's magazine, with the hope of landing a date with a hot model. Adam steps in to play the groom in Audrey's wedding-themed shoot.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Jeff’s New Friend
programme.desc: Jeff is surprised when Audrey informs him that the new friend he made at the gym is gay. Meanwhile, Russell worries the young woman he's dating might be his daughter.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Voluntary Commitment
programme.desc: After a long line of female assistants, Russell learns that having a male assistant can be very advantageous. Meanwhile, after volunteering to read to the elderly, Audrey makes a bet with Jeff that she can commit to finishing a project.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Dad's Visit
programme.desc: Much to Audrey's dismay, Jeff's chauvinist father, who expects Audrey to wait on him hand and foot, extends his visit after spraining his ankle. Meanwhile, Russell has a one-night stand with a woman who won't leave his apartment.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Russell's Secret
programme.desc: Audrey discovers that Russell is a closeted fan of Broadway musicals, a fact she promises to keep secret in exchange for free theater tickets. Meanwhile, Adam and Jennifer take dancing lessons in preparation for their wedding.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Moonscape
programme.desc: Augur is forced to take part in a Taelon experiment. Da'an and Liam try to convince Zo'or that altering minds and implanting humans to make them aggressive to fight the Jaridians is not the correct path. Maiya makes contact with Sandoval.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Sleepers
programme.desc: A Jaridian probe lands on Earth and begins sucking energy from the Comonality. The Taelons use humans in a near-death state to keep their connection while Lili and Sandoval try to find out what is draining the energy.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Fissures
programme.desc: When large scale blackouts begin to occur in cities with portals, Taelon technology is blamed. Augur and Liam investigate the death of a portal worker by a strange creature that feeds on energy and is particularly attracted to the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Redemption
programme.desc: Siobhan falls while rock climbing. As the others search for her, she dreams that she is on trial for supporting the Taelons. Zo'or questions whether Sandoval's CVI imperative to serve the Taelons has broken down as others are experiencing.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Between Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: Dr. Belman's daughter does human testing on herself with an accelerant that causes her to rapidly evolve. Joshua Doors decides somebody should run against President Thompson in the election, somebody who will stand up to the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Isabel
programme.desc: Maiya experiences dimensional phasing. Augur and Liam believe they need to bring Isabel and Maiya together to let the universe merge them. Jonathan Doors announces his presidential candidacy and meets with Zo'or.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict
programme.desc: An escaped Jiridian takes Lili hostage. Their shuttle is sucked on to a Kimera ship where they, with Liam, have to go through an obstacle course to get to the core to exit.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict
programme.desc: Using Jiridian technology, scientists create a physical bio surrogates where a human consciousness can be transferred. When a surrogate escapes, they must find it before it uses its fighting and weapons knowledge.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Second Chances
programme.desc: A Taelon program offers a transformation into a younger, healthier version of oneself. Liam fears that something more dangerous is also happening. Lili is worried that Doors' run for the presidency is negatively affecting the resistance.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Payback
programme.desc: A mysterious death by poisoning creates questions about the safety of portal technology. When a Taelon is killed in the same manner, the investigation leads to a very smart scientist that even the Resistance was scared to work with.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Paul Chandler plots an attack on the Taelon Embassy in DC with the ship he stole from Lili. He begs her to join him in beginning an all out war.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Volunteers
programme.desc: A group of Resistance capture a volunteer from a Taelon program for youth. Liam decides they may learn valuable information from her. They also decide to send in one of their own as a volunteer to see what the program is teaching.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Bliss
programme.desc: Lili is given a psychotropic drug called "bliss" via a Taelon device. They discover it is widespread. With an instantly strong addictive property, the addicts are dying within 48 hours. The investigation leads Liam and Sandoval to Ireland.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Highjacked
programme.desc: With a reporter on board, the Taelon mother ship is highjacked into interdimensional space. Liam is the prime suspect, causing an even bigger rift between Da'an and Zo'or. As the ship floats, lost in space, they must find the real culprit.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Defector
programme.desc: A shuttle crashes on a beach after being pursued by a second Taelon piloted shuttle. When Liam locates the survivor (a Taelon called Belleye), he claims to want to help the Resistance take back Earth from the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Heroes and Heartbreak
programme.desc: Augur is recruited by a Taelon weapons project, but the others are worried about his involvement. When the project is launched earlier than originally planned to fight a Jiridian fleet, the Earth is in danger.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Message in a Bottle
programme.desc: A Jiridian probe headed for Earth is shot down by the Taelon Embassy and crashes outside of D.C. Liam recovers the probe, but he, Augur, and Julia are captured by another underground resistance movement led by the real Colonel Liam Kincaid.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Crossfire
programme.desc: As the election draws near, Liam believes Zo'or is trying to have Jonathan Doors murdered. The Resistance worries that an attack is imminent at the final debate. Julia mobilizes a group to protect Doors against Liam's wishes.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Crackdown
programme.desc: An unknown woman saves Augur and Liam from the raids on the Resistance. Lili sabotages the mother ship, but Zo'or stops its total destruction. Lili is reportedly dead. The investigation on the President's shooter continues.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Vanished
programme.desc: Some who were detained during the Resistance sweep have not reappeared after their release. Lili is taken to a lab run by Sandoval and implanted. Renee tries to help Liam find the missing people.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Emancipation
programme.desc: A group posing as volunteers attacks using a stolen skrill prototype that does not require an implant to control. It is discovered that the skrill queen is also missing. The investigation leads to a resistance group called Black Wednesday.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: You Call This Plainclothes?
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place involving prostitutes, Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) go undercover in the hopes of finding who keeps killing the women. Also starring Al Waxman, Carl Lumbly, and John Karlen.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Pop Used To Work In Chinatown
programme.desc: A Chinatown robbery brings Cagney's retired father back on the beat to show his daughter how to properly conduct an investigation. Guest starring Dick O'Neill as Charlie Cagney. Tyne Daly, Meg Foster, Al Waxman, and Carl Lumbly star.
programme.sub-title: Pop Used To Work In Chinatown

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Beyond The Golden Door
programme.desc: In the hopes of finding a missing child, Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) go undercover as workers in the garment industry and end up helping an undocumented worker from Guatemala find her sister's murderer.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Suffer The Children
programme.desc: Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) become involved in an investigation of child abuse and possible murder when they rescue a four-year-old child from a window ledge. Also starring Al Waxman, Carl Lumbly, and John Karlen.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Better Than Equal
programme.desc: Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) must ignore their feminist sentiments when they are assigned to protect the life of ERA critic, Helen Granger (guest star Julie Adams), who is being harassed by a caller who is threatening her life.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Street Scene
programme.desc: After an elderly man (guest star George Petrie) is involved with the death of a gang member, Cagney and Lacey are accused of racial prejudice as they investigate what happened. The truth is finally revealed with the help of the victim's brother.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Witness To An Incident
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) both have differing recollections when it comes to the events surrounding a young officer fatally shooting a civilian. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels and Carl Lumbly as Mark Petrie.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: One Of Our Own
programme.desc: When a fellow police officer is shot and killed in a restaurant, Cagney, and Lacey join in the feverish search for the killer. Meanwhile, Isbecki works to do all that he can to keep the duo off of the precinct's softball team.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Beauty Burglars
programme.desc: Detectives Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are assigned to a special task force to investigate a series of beauty salon robberies. The case becomes more complicated when it is discovered that the burglars are posing as police officers.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: High Steel
programme.desc: Harvey (John Karlen) disagrees with the outcome of an investigation after a former colleague falls to his death at a construction site. Harvey recruits Mary Beth (Tyne Daly) to help him investigate what he believes to be a murder.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Hotline
programme.desc: After three women are found strangled, Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate whether or not there is a connection between the attacks and an erotic hotline. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are assigned by Internal Affairs to check out a security leak among the 14th Precinct's personnel, forcing the duo to reluctantly spy on their colleagues. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Mr. Lonelyhearts
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are called in when an elderly man comes looking for his wife. But a simple missing persons case soon turns into a major bigamy and fraud case. All the while Cagney deals with a suitor.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Conduct Unbecoming
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) team together with another detective, Charles Stephens (guest star Christopher Allport), to investigate an illegal handgun operation. However, their investigation is impeded by Charles's suspension.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: I'll Be Home For Christmas
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are looking forward to an early release on Christmas Eve when a man dressed as Santa Claus (guest star Richard Masur), who has been arrested for charity fraud, escapes from his cell in the 14th precinct.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Recreational Use
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey team up with Sergeant Dory McKenna (guest star Barry Primus) in an investigation of a group of senior citizens terrorized by their landlord. Cagney's romance with Dory is complicated by his addiction to cocaine.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Hopes And Dreams
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate a series of burglaries that occurred while all of the victims were at funerals. They become especially interested in a young teenage victim, who is bound to a wheelchair.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Grandest Jewel Thief Of Them All
programme.desc: Lacey (Tyne Daly) becomes worried when Cagney (Sharon Gless) becomes obsessed with catching notorious jewel thief Albert Grand (guest star Ferdy Mayne), who despite committing several hotel safe robberies has never been convicted.
programme.sub-title: Grandest Jewel Thief Of Them All

programme.desc: ¡BTR tiene que impedir la invasión de los grupos británicos de chicos! Ya que Gustavo está demasiado disperso, los chicos contratan a un agente musical famoso, pero al no ponerse de acuerdo, el grupo se disuelve y la brecha se acentúa en el grupo.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El gran escándalo
programme.desc: Lucy publica su album de venganza contra Kendall con gran éxito. James, desesperado por llamar la atención, difunde el rumor de que va a grabar un duo con Cher Lloyd y Carlos recibe mala prensa al golpear, supuestamente, a una anciana.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes mentiras
programme.desc: Kendall debe impedir que Jo descubra que Lucy ha vuelto a Palm Woods. La mentirijilla de Logan sobre estar enfermo acaba convirtiéndose en una emergencia médica y Carlos y James alegan que se ha producido un robo en Rocque Records.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran bonificación
programme.desc: Gustavo entrega una prima a los chicos por haber trabajado bien pero estos no tardan en tomar malas decisiones sobre el dinero.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran actuación especial
programme.desc: BTR participan en una serie infantil pero los intentos de Carlos por ligar con la estrella del programa le pone en el punto de mira de la malvada madre de la artista. Logan y James luchan con Yo GAbba Gabba por el increíble bufé del estudio.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes bromas II
programme.desc: Vuelve la guerra de las bromas a Palm Woods y esta vez son los chicos contra los adultos los que combaten por el honor de ganar la copa de Lord Prankington.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes rulos
programme.desc: James sigue intentando ligarse a Lucy y compra una moto para impresionarla pero no sabe conducirla. Kendall enseña a Jo a manejar la palanca de cambios y Carlos y Logan no pueden renunciar a un tesoro de la infancia.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El gran test
programme.desc: Logan se lleva consigo a Carlos al examen de MCAT como amuleto de la suerte, pero cuando Carlos saca mejor nota que él, Logan se cuestiona su idoneidad para la medicina.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes dibujos animados
programme.desc: Los chicos tienen un contrato para una serie de dibujos animados pero en cambio hacen un videojuego. Un malentendido mientras llevan sus trajes de captura de movimientos los sitúa en el centro de una noticia sobre extraterrestres.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran ruptura
programme.desc: Advertidos de que los grupos de chicos se disuelven siempre tras el tercer album, los chicos compiten por conseguir bolos en solitario para no quedarse atrás.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran gira en autobús
programme.desc: BTR sale de gira con Victoria Justice y subiremos al autobús con ellos para presenciar la locura de abordo. Cuando se ven retenidos por culpa de un atasco, Victoria tendrá que entretener al público hasta que lleguen los chicos.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran entrega de premios (Parte 1)
programme.desc: ¡Es la entrega de los premios Tween Choice, BTR está nominado y ha sido contratado para cerrar el evento! Sin embargo, su noche se empaña cuando los chicos descubren un plan diabólico para lavar el cerebro al público.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La gran entrega de premios (Parte 2)
programme.desc: ¡Es la entrega de los premios Tween Choice, BTR está nominado y ha sido contratado para cerrar el evento! Sin embargo, su noche se empaña cuando los chicos descubren un plan diabólico para lavar el cerebro al público.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La película
programme.desc: Big Time Rush is off to London on their first world tour, but as soon as they arrive they're mixed up in a mission to save the world. The soundtrack to the adventure is Big Time Rush performing songs from the greatest band in the world: The Beatles.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Audición Parte 1
programme.desc: Prepárate para hacer un viaje extraordinario junto a estos cuatro grandes amigos que se lanzan de forma inesperada desde Minnesota hasta la glamurosa ciudad de Los Ángeles. Descubre el panorama musical de la ciudad y lo que la convierte en grande.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Audición Parte 2
programme.desc: Prepárate para hacer un viaje extraordinario junto a estos cuatro grandes amigos que se lanzan de forma inesperada desde Minnesota hasta la glamurosa ciudad de Los Ángeles. Descubre el panorama musical de la ciudad y lo que la convierte en grande.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Keli
programme.desc: Los chicos no están satisfechos con su aburrido apartamento en Palm Woods y planean mejorarlo cuando Gustavo crea una zona falsa para vivir en un estudio de sonido para una próxima sesión de EPK.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Escuela De Rocque
programme.desc: Los chicos se enfrentan a la realidad cuando Gustavo les dice que tienen que volver a la escuela mientras están viviendo en Los Ángeles.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Malote
programme.desc: El presidente de la compañía discográfica piensa que añadiendo un quinto miembro a la banda ampliará el atractivo de 'Big Time Rush'. Ese nuevo miembro será el chico malo que intenta inyectar guerra y tensión en el grupo.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Balada De Amor
programme.desc: Los chicos están detrás de la misma chica, algo que causará problemas en la banda desde el primer momento.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Mansión
programme.desc: Cuando Gustavo se tiene que ir fuera por negocios deja a los chicos al cuidado de su mansión. Ellos intentan hacer lo mejor para mantener la casa en su estado original, sin embargo, inevitablemente destruyen todos los objetos de valor de Gustavo.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Sesión Fotografica
programme.desc: La presión sube cuando los chicos se preparan para la primera foto de la banda, porque esa foto puede aparecer en todas las revistas de adolescentes.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Ruptura
programme.desc: Pasar todo el tiempo juntos desde que llegaron a Los Ángeles les ha creado cierto agobio a los chicos, así que deciden pasar un tiempo separados.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Maqueta
programme.desc: Han pasado tres meses desde que los chicos de 'Big Time Rush' se mudaron a Hollywood para grabar sus maquetas. Ahora el futuro de la banda depende de la decisión de Griffin.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Fiestón
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que no están invitados a una fiesta que Gustavo está preparando en el estudio, los chcios deciden organizar su propia fiesta en Palm Woods.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: La Gran Fiebre
programme.desc: Los chicos están viviendo un continuo sueño de Hollywood, sin embargo James, Logan y Carlos muestran un comportamiento extraño.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes Trabajos
programme.desc: Los chicos han tenido demasiada diversión viviendo en Hollywood. Además, tras destrozar algunas cosas en Palmwoods, Gustavo cree que ha tenido suficiente y hace que los chicos trabajen.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Terror
programme.desc: Gustavo necesita un sitio donde quedarse mientras fumigan su mansión y la madre le invita al Crib. Al mismo tiempo sucede algo de 'Actividad Paranormal' en Palm Woods.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Baile
programme.desc: Los chicos están organizando el primer baile de la escuela en Palm Woods y 'Big Time Rush' se ha asegurado el sitio perfecto... El estudio de grabación de Gustavo.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Blog
programme.desc: Gustavo piensa que es el momento de crear expectación en torno a "Big Time Rush" a través de una entrevista con un famoso bloguero, Deke. Deke es conocido por poder crear o destruir una carrera profesional, por lo que los chicos deben hacerlo bien.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Grandes Chispas
programme.desc: Jordin Sparks está en Palm Woods mientras graba una nueva canción con Gustavo. Los chicos tienen que estar lejos de ella porque le traen mala suerte.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: El Gran Videoclip
programme.desc: Gustavo anuncia que los chicos van a grabar su primer vídeo musical. A los chicos se les va de las manos y prometen demasiados papeles a todos los chicos de Palm Woods.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Alicia lleva unos enfermos y lastimados pingüinos al centro de rescate. Su bote queda atrapado en el hielo. Diego y bebé jaguar rescatan a Alicia y los pingüinos.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Programa de humor basado en los seis pilares que siempre han definido el humor de José Mota: Sketches, Apartes, Musicales, Parodias televisivas y cinematográficas, Imitaciones y Personajes. Con la participación de Juan Muñoz.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Abraham Mateo es el invitado especial de este programa, en el que comparte con la Blasa su éxito 'Señorita'. Además, se realiza un homenaje al periodista Jesús Hermida, tristemente desaparecido esta semana.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Programa de humor basado en los seis pilares que siempre han definido el humor de José Mota: Sketches, Apartes, Musicales, Parodias televisivas y cinematográficas, Imitaciones y Personajes. Con la participación del grupo musical Dvicio.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Amaia Montero participa en José Mota Presenta para compartir con Tomás uno de sus éxitos más recientes. En ‘El ministerio del tiempo’, los agentes habituales están acompañados de Blasa, para cumplir una misión relacionada con el Tratado de Utrecht.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: La cantante Merche, invitada especial de este programa, en el que emulará a Olivia Newton John en el musical '50 sombras de Grease'. En la parodia de los 'Gipsy Kings', Los Chunguitos y Richy Castellanos viajarán a América.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Programa de humor protagonizado por José Mota.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Una entrega en la que se verá la relación del cuñado histórico con Edvard Munch, las aventuras de Tony Folledo en su última etapa y un musical protagonizado por la pareja. Además, una divertida versión de 'Perfectos desconocidos'.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Una entrega en la que se conocerá al cuñado de Darwin y se parodiarán los programas ‘Master Chef’ y ‘Comando Actualidad’. Además, Jacintus XL intentará ligar en Internet.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Bertín Osborne entrevista en “En la tuya o en la mía” a Pedro Almódovar. En 'Planeta Collejas', Antonio Ferreras sufrirá los inconvenientes de esta apuesta televisiva.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Nuevas imitaciones, musicales y personajes, apostando por nuevas formas de contar las situaciones cómicas, más cercanas al humor absurdo y, como siempre, manteniendo su compromiso con la realidad social.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: Veremos una parodia muy divertida de ‘En tu casa o en la mía’ en la que Bertín Osborne entrevistará a Miguel Ángel Revilla.

programme.title: José Mota Presenta: Jose Mota Presenta ES
programme.desc: José Mota Presenta recupera a una de sus nuevas creaciones, el tractorista Demetrio Cansalmas. También trae una divertida parodia de la serie 'Vis a vis' y de 'Al rojo vivo', entre otros programas.

programme.title: El Lute II: Mañana seré libre
programme.desc: El Lute escapa de la prisión de El Puerto de Santa María. Lo primero que hace tras su huida es acudir a sus hermanos para pedirles ayuda.

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: El Lute: Camina o revienta
programme.desc: En 1960, una familia de quinquis recorre Extremadura. La vida tan dura que llevan causa la muerte de la madre. El hijo, Eleuterio Sánchez, roba unas gallinas y es condenado a seis meses de cárcel...

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir. El film obtuvo 3 nominaciones a los Oscar, 2011.

programme.title: Darkness
programme.desc: A una adolescente y su familia le suceden fenómenos extraños después de haberse mudado a una casa de campo.

programme.title: Amor a quemarropa
programme.desc: En Detroit, un friki de la cultura pop se casa con una puta, le roba cocaína a su chulo, e intenta venderla en Hollywood. Los propietarios de la coca les siguen la pista para recuperarla.

programme.title: The Dead Girl ES
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Tras un divorcio difícil, Lucas, de cuarenta años, ha conocido a otra mujer, tiene un nuevo trabajo y se dispone a reconstruir la relación con Marcus, su hijo adolescente. Pero algo va mal. Un detalle. Un comentario inocente. Una mentira fortuita.

programme.title: Mentira de familias
programme.desc: Después de que sus padres murieran en lo que parece un accidente de coche, Emily y sus hermanos menores se mudan a un pequeño pueblo de Luisiana. Pronto comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas, dando a los hermanos la sensación de que están siendo observados.

programme.title: Más Allá De La Onda Expansiva
programme.desc: Un artificiero inculpado decide escapar de la vigilancia policial para tratar de descubrir la verdad

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: Tipos Legales
programme.desc: Val (Al Pacino) sale de la cárcel tras cumplir 28 años de condena. Doc (Christopher Walken), su mejor amigo, le espera a la salida para ir a ver a Hirsch (Alan Arkin), otro viejo colega.

programme.title: White Space
programme.desc: La tripulación de una nave pesquera espacial se enfrenta a una criatura cósmica gigantesca y mortal mientras opera en un sector inexplorado del espacio.

programme.title: Perdidos en el sol
programme.desc: Delincuente y huérfano roban juntos.

programme.title: 12 balas
programme.desc: Dean Ambrose, la superestrella de la WWE, hace de Shaw, un detective que vuelve al servicio activo tras la muerte de su compañero. Cuando descubre pruebas que relacionan a sus compañeros con un asesinato, le incriminan en un homicidio que no cometió.

programme.title: El último hijo
programme.desc: El forajido Isaac LeMay está en las últimas, perseguido como un perro. Está dispuesto a acabar con todo, pero su maldición permanece. Su hijo Cal es aún peor que él, y deja un reguero de sangre y destrucción por donde pasa.

programme.title: Nacido campeón
programme.desc: Mickey que dejar atrás todo lo que ama para participar en un torneo clandestino de MMA

programme.title: El hotel de los fantasmas
programme.desc: El propietario de un castillo irlandés, agobiado por sus numerosas deudas, decide convertir su castillo en un hotel. El proyecto no cuaja, pero se le ocurre proclamar falsamente que el castillo está habitado por terribles fantasmas.

programme.title: Tres pequeños ninjas
programme.desc: Tres hermanos han sido entrenados desde muy pequeños por su abuelo. Un día, un viejo "amigo" de éste vuelve a dar señales de vida pero el FBI le está investigando por una serie de turbios asuntos y pretende librarse de cualquier manera.

programme.title: El super chef
programme.desc: Un cocinero chino accidentalmente se ve envuelto en un reportaje que se está filmando sobre un intercambio de droga que resulta fallido. La mafia comienza a perseguirle para conseguir la cinta.

programme.title: Hiena salvaje
programme.desc: Shing Lung (Jackie Chan) pasó toda su niñez aprendiendo el estilo secreto de Kung Fu de su abuelo. Su abuelo siempre lo advirtió de mantener el secreto del arte, pero Lung nunca rechazaba una pelea, lo que originó desastrosos resultados.

programme.title: El permiso
programme.desc: Cuando a una reclusa se le concede un fin de semana fuera de prisión para ver a su madre moribunda, un oficial de corrección novato lucha por mantenerla bajo control.

programme.title: La segunda oportunidad
programme.desc: Una madre divorciada intenta hacer las paces con su disfuncional familia encontrando una segunda oportunidad en el amor.

programme.title: Piranha Sharks
programme.desc: Mediante bioingeniería se ha conseguido reducir el tamaño de los grandes tiburones blancos al de las pirañas para adornar los exóticos acuarios.

programme.title: Diario de un ejecutivo agresivo
programme.desc: Jack Giamoro, el mejor cazatalentos de Los Ángeles, parece tenerlo todo: una carrera de éxito, dinero y una hermosa mujer. Pero se siente vacío y decide asistir a las clases de creación literaria del pomposo y temperamental sr. Primkin.

programme.title: Los líos de Gray
programme.desc: Gray y Sam (Heather Graham y Tom Cavanagh) son hermanos, pero tan compatibles e inseparables que la gente cree que son pareja.

programme.title: Atraco por duplicado
programme.desc: Cuando le toman como rehén durante el atraco a un banco, un hombre se propone proteger a la guapa cajera de la que se ha enamorado perdidamente.

programme.title: Con la magia en los zapatos
programme.desc: Un zapatero, aburrido de su vida cotidiana, tropieza con una reliquia mágica que le permite convertirse en otras personas y ver el mundo de otra manera.

programme.title: Memoria Perdida
programme.desc: Un periodista con pérdida de memoria regresa a su pueblo natal y se reencuentra con su tío y antiguo amor.

programme.title: Dictado
programme.desc: Tras quedarse huérfana, Julia es acogida por Daniel y Laura. Daniel percibe en la conducta de la niña un carácter amenazador que le trae a la memoria un pasado terrorífico que había decidido enterrar para siempre.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Tras un trágico accidente, un hombre se convierte en el objetivo de la peligrosa obsesión de otro testigo.

programme.title: Darkness
programme.desc: A una adolescente y su familia le suceden fenómenos extraños después de haberse mudado a una casa de campo.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: Tras una temporada en Pekín, Roy y Jessie deciden viajar a Moscú en el Transiberiano, el ferrocarril que une la Rusia europea con las provincias rusas del Lejano Oriente.

programme.title: Llamada oculta
programme.desc: Un psicópata utiliza el sistema de seguridad de alta tecnología de una familia para atraparlos en su propia casa.

programme.title: Webcam de animadoras
programme.desc: Maisy se traslada a la universidad de su difunta hermana para investigar las circunstancias de su muerte.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: Sonia Paston acepta una gran promoción laboral que significa dejar su vida en Nueva York para mudarse a un pequeño pueblo cerca de Boston. Aún si ella esta lista para irse, alguien no esta dispuesto a vivir sin ella.

programme.title: Vacaciones en el infierno
programme.desc: En Vacaciones en el infierno conoceremos a Driver (Mel Gibson), un tipo que ha tenido un mal día. Y la cosa no mejora para él: se ha hecho con un botín de millones de dólares que le habría proporcionado unas vacaciones de verano memorables.

programme.title: Amor a quemarropa
programme.desc: En Detroit, un friki de la cultura pop se casa con una puta, le roba cocaína a su chulo, e intenta venderla en Hollywood. Los propietarios de la coca les siguen la pista para recuperarla.

programme.title: En lo profundo del bosque
programme.desc: Tommaso, un niño de 4 años, desaparece durante un festival. Cinco años después, encontraron a un niño sin nombre y sin documentos. Coincidencias de ADN: él es Tommi, pero su madre se pregunta si ese niño no es realmente su hijo.

programme.title: Hierro 3
programme.desc: Tae-suk, que okupa casas, encuentra a Sun-hwa, maltratada por su marido. Ella se une a su vida errante hasta que son descubiertos. Tras ser encarcelado, él la busca para recuperarla.

programme.title: El Arco
programme.desc: Un pescador protege en el mar a la joven que recogió de niña, esperando casarse a sus 17. Usa su arco como arma, música y oráculo. La llegada de un universitario enamora a la chica, acabando el sueño del anciano.

programme.title: Conociendo a Matsuko
programme.desc: Sho, un músico en Tokio, debe limpiar el apartamento de su tía Matsuko, recientemente asesinada. Intrigado por su vida desconocida, Sho descubre a una mujer fascinante que siempre creyó que el valor de la vida está en lo que uno hace por los demás.

programme.title: Happy End
programme.desc: A nuestro alrededor, el mundo, y nosotros en medio, ciegos. Una instantánea de la vida de una familia burguesa europea.

programme.title: El tercer asesinato
programme.desc: El conocido abogado Shigemori defiende a Misumi, acusado de robo con homicidio, que ya cumplió pena de cárcel por otro asesinato hace treinta años.

programme.title: Happy End
programme.desc: A nuestro alrededor, el mundo, y nosotros en medio, ciegos. Una instantánea de la vida de una familia burguesa europea.

programme.title: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Una joven y atractiva mujer viaja a lo largo y ancho de la campiña, pensando un hombre, y en un momento concreto para a cambiarse su ropa de diario para ponerse un flamante vestido.

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: Gracias a Dios
programme.desc: Alexandre vive en Lyon con su esposa e hijos. Por casualidad, se entera de que el sacerdote que abusó de él cuando era un boy scout sigue trabajando con niños. Se lanza a un combate al que se unen otras víctimas del sacerdote…

programme.title: Red Dog, una historia de lealtad
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película cuenta cómo un perro recorre Australia creando vínculos con los habitantes de un pueblo minero, convirtiéndose en un símbolo de amistad y lealtad.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta
programme.desc: Dos actores de fenómenos televisivos (Juego de Tronos y Sex Education) protagonizan este fantástico romance. Un joven (Asa Butterfield) inventa una máquina del tiempo para recuperar a su exnovia (Sophie Turner).

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Un hombre convence a su amigo para trabajar como gigoló, lo que provoca situaciones cómicas y complicadas.

programme.title: Recuerdos del corazón
programme.desc: With her husband jailed for Wall Street fraud, Faith leaves her life of luxury behind to return to rural North Carolina and the father and sister she'd left behind.

programme.title: A Second Chance
programme.desc: Maddy Cornel (Emily Morris) es una niña de 12 años cuyo sueño es ser gimnasta profesional, pero su nivel de autoestima y su poca confianza en sí misma suponen una barrera para empezar a conquistar su sueño.

programme.title: Dance-Off
programme.desc: Brandon y Jasmine son dos bailarines pertenecientes a academias rivales que deben competir por un gran premio. En su viaje a la final el enfrentamiento se va convirtiendo en amor.

programme.title: Los líos de Gray
programme.desc: Gray y Sam (Heather Graham y Tom Cavanagh) son hermanos, pero tan compatibles e inseparables que la gente cree que son pareja.

programme.title: Mensaje De Amor En Una Botella
programme.desc: Desafortunadamente en el amor, Abbey comparte las frustraciones de sus citas con su tía, quien sugiere que escriba una carta de amor explicando los deseos de su verdadero corazón.

programme.title: La felicidad nunca viene sola
programme.desc: Un músico conoce a una mujer con una vida muy distinta y ambos se enamoran.

programme.title: De nuevo el amor
programme.desc: Chloe y David han decidido terminar su matrimonio pero antes de poderle decir a su hija, ella los soprende con la noticia de su compromiso.

programme.title: Regreso a Montauk
programme.desc: El escritor Max Zorn regresa a Nueva York para la promoción de su última novela, donde le espera su joven esposa Clara, quien lleva meses trabajando allí.

programme.title: Bob Esponja
programme.desc: ¿Quién vive en la piña debajo del mar? ¡Bob Esponja! Sumérgete en Fondo de Bikini para vivir las aventuras más desternillantes con Bob Esponja, Patricio y Calamardo.
